newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to make important announcement on North.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to make important announcement on North.

text.p: South Korea said it would make an important announcement on North Korea on Wednesday, and Yonhap Television News said a senior North Korean official had defected to the South.
Yonhap said the defector was Hwang Jang-yop, a secretary at the communist country's ruling Workers' Party.
A string of officials from the impoverished North have defected to South Korea in recent years, including diplomats, air force pilots and foreign exchange dealers.
North Korea, whose economy has contracted in the past six years, has been suffering from an acute food shortage in recent years, due partly to devastating floods.
